primary_result: The SHA-bound sequence-2 development-screening qualification passed evidence identity, complete scene coverage, and the measurement-null validity veto, but local utility over global and bidirectional repeatability were both unfavorable. Under the frozen valid_utility_failure decision rule, these decisive outcomes establish COMPLETED_GATE_FAIL, close the local-restoration-need qualification family, and authorize no S2, model change, training, deployment, or scientific promotion.
gate_reasons: The evidence_identity, development_scene_coverage, and measurement_null_artifact validity-veto gates all passed, so no validity failure forced an inconclusive terminal.

The local_utility_over_global decisive gate was unfavorable: strong same-observation local-oracle and spatial-specificity aggregates did not overcome the excessive cross-observation negative tail required by the frozen composite gate.

The bidirectional_repeatability decisive gate was unfavorable: the transferred local map did not achieve the frozen material-effect requirement and the stability, keep-supported, and negative-tail requirements were not jointly satisfied.
The near_clear_fidelity gate was indeterminate because the frozen cross-dataset support requirement was not met, but this does not override either decisive unfavorable utility gate.
The primary_precision gate was unmet because the frozen null-absence precision conditions were not all satisfied. This gate is inconclusive_only and cannot hide a decisive scientific FAIL.
competing_explanation: The aggregate evidence shows substantial privileged local opportunity and spatial specificity within the same observation, with the strongest transferred effect concentrated in OTS. However, Haze4K and ITS did not show a comparable transferable advantage, the cross-observation negative tail was excessive, direction-and-strength stability was insufficient, and no scene satisfied the frozen keep-supported criterion. The evidence therefore supports observation- and dataset-dependent local oracle behavior rather than the program's required robust bidirectional local-error operationalization.
limitations: The evidence is development-screening only and does not include confirmation, canary, sealed-final, NH-Haze, or locked-test data.
Ground truth is used only by a privileged offline diagnostic oracle; this route makes no inference-time observability or deployability claim.
The global comparator is limited to one scene-global residual strength on the frozen 1001-point interval and is not a claim over arbitrary restoration operators.
Each original clear scene contributes once; haze observations, content-aligned regions, pixels, actions, and bootstrap draws remain nested.
Near-clear fidelity remained indeterminate because only one dataset met the frozen exposure requirement, so this route does not establish a cross-dataset near-clear safety conclusion.
Exact RGB and archived known-overlap controls do not prove complete source-provenance disjointness.
No network training, trainable mechanism selection, protected-data access, S2 activity, or deployment occurred.
